voiceEnrollment.privacyItem2: Embeddings are used only by the server-side diarization job; they're never sent back to the app.
voiceEnrollment.privacyItem3: Stored in encrypted storage compliant with Japan's Personal Information Protection Act (APPI).
voiceEnrollment.privacyItem4: Click 'delete' at any time to permanently remove your voice profile within 30 days.
voiceEnrollment.biometricNotice: Voice embeddings are classified as biometric data. Enrollment is fully voluntary — never required for work. Without enrollment, diarization still works via the 'first speaker = staff' heuristic.

tactic.jouren_pack: A trusted regular. Their pass is likely running low — a natural moment to suggest securing the next sessions today.
tactic.jouren_nopack: A steady regular. Mention that a pass works out cheaper than paying each time — a good first pass to offer.
tactic.antei_pack: Relationship is established. In step with their pass usage, suggest returning around the same interval.
tactic.antei_nopack: Relationship is established. Use their average interval to lock in the next booking on the spot.
tactic.ridatsugimi_pack: A longer gap than usual. Open warmly. Prioritise a visit before the pass expires so it is not wasted.
tactic.ridatsugimi_nopack: A longer gap than usual. Do not push a sale — focus on securing the next booking to get back into rhythm.
tactic.shinki: First visit today. Confirm how they feel rather than selling. Show the next timing and aim only to book visit 2.
